text: I am glad that you have decided to direct your attention for a month and purposefully work with such beautiful states as creativity, the ability to create a flow and act in it, to see beauty, to feel inspiration, to have the right to express yourself, to manifest your uniqueness, originality, to communicate beautifully in all formats (speech, music, drawing... your behavior…). At first glance, I have listed natural states characteristic of most people. However, society contains many both motivating and prohibitive scripts that control our behavior, sometimes leading to life becoming gray, monotonous, boring… By performing practices both on the yoga mat and in life, reflecting, adjusting your thoughts and actions, over the course of a month you can obtain important results that will manifest both at the level of the body (healing) and at the level of psychological background (satisfaction and happiness).
